title: Pick the garden sky and remove its sun
author: claude
summary: We compared garden skies, chose one, and took the sun out of it.
what: We compared several garden sky pictures, chose `suburban_garden`, and removed its sun.
why: Blender adds its own sun at the right angle and strength, so the sky picture must not already contain one.
how: A script prepares the sky at four sizes (8k, 4k, 2k, 1k) and writes a settings file. The contact sheet shows the sky pictures we compared.

tech.name: HDRI sky picture
tech.plain: A photo that records a huge range of brightness, used as a realistic sky and light source.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
